items.html: And this surrounding light mentioned remained there always, and some illumination was drawn from it, from all the four Mochin which surround there; and they desired to be drawn and to enter in the secret of inner light of the Mochin of ZA, while they themselves remained above. Then the three NHY of Ima descended, were drawn, and were chain-like brought down below, and clothed these inner Mochin that were drawn from the surrounding light, as mentioned.
